title: Engine Emission Control — Component Location
introduction:
This drawing locates the crankcase vent oil separator. I use the broad, ribbed intake assembly as a roof-shaped landmark: the cyan-highlighted housing sits below it on the side of the engine. Trace the callout from that housing to the accompanying table to confirm its identity.

Match the engine designation below before using the view. The illustration shows the component among the surrounding engine parts, but that generous sightline is no promise of easy access in the car. Use this page for recognition and location; it supplies neither a removal sequence nor a test that would establish whether the separator is working.

edits.why: The engine designation determines which location drawing applies. Use the highlighted housing and the intake assembly above it as visual landmarks, with the table providing the component identification.
